subject.title: fix(codex): MEMORY.md silently truncated when memory plugin exposes only memory_recall

question: Should a generic `memory_recall` tool be allowed to replace root `MEMORY.md` bootstrap injection, or must a memory plugin explicitly declare support for retrieving that workspace file first?
rationale: The current tool name and LanceDB implementation establish generic vector recall only; choosing a durable-memory equivalence contract is an owner-level integration decision rather than a mechanical allowlist correction.

options.title: Require an explicit file-recall capability
options.body: Keep the existing injection path until the active memory plugin declares and tests that its recall tool indexes root `MEMORY.md`.

options.title: Make LanceDB index the workspace file
options.body: Adopt tool routing only after the LanceDB plugin explicitly ingests and retrieves the root workspace file with upgrade-safe coverage.

recommendation.title: Require an explicit file-recall capability
recommendation.body: Keep the existing injection path until the active memory plugin declares and tests that its recall tool indexes root `MEMORY.md`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server ownership is the closest decision surface for its bootstrap-routing contract.
